changes.oldText: First, log in with an admin account and create a project folder. After moving to the Data page, click Create Folder to open the folder creation dialog. Enter the folder name, set the Type to Project. When the type is set to Project, it will be automatically assigned to the project selected in the project selector in the header. Permission is set to Read-Only.

section.text: Share project storage folders with project members

changes.newText: First, log in with an admin account and create a project folder. Move to the admin Data page (/admin/data) and click Create Folder to open the folder creation dialog. The dialog has no folder type selection — a banner at the top states Folders are created as project folders on the Admin Data Page. — so you pick the owning project in the Target Project field at the top of the form. The remaining fields (Folder name, Usage Mode, Location, and Mount Permission) work the same as on the user Data page, except that Usage Mode offers only General and Models, because a project folder cannot be an auto-mount folder. For the full field descriptions, refer to the Create storage folder section. For this walkthrough, set Mount Permission to Read only.
